desc:
CRISPY GRAHAM SQUARES: Enjoy crispy, delicious graham squares, ideal for adults and kids

GRAHAM CRACKER TASTE: Every bowl tastes like the irresistible pairing of graham crackers and milk from childhood

WHOLE GRAIN GOODNESS: Each serving provides 14g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily) and a good source of calcium, with 12 vitamins and minerals

BREAKFAST ADDITION OR SNACK: Serve this cereal as part of a quick breakfast, or add to cereal bars recipes, homemade trail mix, and other on the go snacks

CONTAINS: One 11.7 oz cereal box of General Mills Golden Grahams Cereal
features:
• CEREAL FOR KIDS OR ADULTS: Enjoy crispy, delicious graham squares, ideal for adults and kids; A perfect pantry staple
  • GRAHAM CRACKER TASTE: A family favorite, every bowl of this ready to eat cereal tastes like the irresistible pairing of graham crackers and milk from childhood
  • WHOLE GRAIN: Each serving of this cold cereal provides 14g whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and has a good source of calcium
  • BREAKFAST ADDITION OR SNACK: Serve this cereal for kids as part of a quick breakfast; Add some to homemade kids snacks such as cereal bars recipes, trail mix, and other on the go treats
  • CONTAINS: One cardboard box of crunchy Golden Grahams Breakfast Cereal, Graham Cracker Taste, 11.7 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals
ingredients: Whole Grain Wheat, Corn Meal, Sugar, Brown Sugar Syrup, Canola and/or Sunflower Oil, Dextrose, Baking Soda, Salt, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Rosemary Extract. Vitamins and Minerals: Calcium Carbonate, Tricalcium Phosphate, Vitamin C (sodium ascorbate), Iron and Zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (thiamin mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3.
